tags.name: commerce.todo.tasks.v1
tags.description:
Tasks are what a person intends to do, each with an optional deadline by
which it should be done. A task is open until it is completed; an open
task whose deadline has passed is overdue.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description:
Captures, reads, completes and reopens the caller's tasks, and says which
of them are overdue.

tags.name: commerce.todo.time_tracking.v1
tags.description:
Time tracking is the time a person spends on their tasks: the one timer
they may have running, and the time entries it and they write.

tags.name: Time entries
tags.description:
Records, lists and deletes the caller's time entries, and calculates the
time tracked on a task.

tags.name: Timers
tags.description: Starts, reads and stops the caller's one running timer.

get.description:
Lists the caller's tasks, newest first. Set show to SHOW_OPEN or SHOW_DONE to see only those, or to SHOW_OVERDUE to see only open tasks whose deadline has passed. Use this to find a task's resource name from its title before acting on it. Pages with limit and cursor: pass next_cursor back as cursor until it is empty.

Requires one of the token scopes: `todo/tasks.readonly`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
The most tasks to return; zero returns up to 50, and more than 200 is
read as 200.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next_cursor of the previous page; empty for the first page.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Which tasks to list; unset lists every task, open or done.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: API Version. Send `v4`.

post.description:
Creates a new open task for the caller with a title, optional notes and an optional deadline, and returns it with its resource name (tasks/...). A deadline must not be in the past. Use this when the person mentions something they intend to do.

Requires one of the token scopes: `todo/tasks.write`.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes one of the caller's tasks; it cannot be recovered. A timer running on the task stops and its time entry is kept. Prefer complete_task when the work is finished.

Requires one of the token scopes: `todo/tasks.write`.

May publish the events: `commerce.todo.tasks.task.deleted`. Each event carries only its type and the name of the resource it is about; consumers fetch the resource through this API.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Part of `name`, which has the form `tasks/{task}`.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description:
A unique ID for this request, such as a UUID. Repeating a delete with
the same request_id after a failure succeeds and announces the deletion
again, rather than answering not found.

parameters.description: API Version. Send `v4`.

patch.description:
Changes a task's title, notes or deadline; update_mask names the fields to change (title, notes, deadline_time), and a deadline_time named in update_mask but left empty clears the deadline. A deadline can only be set, moved or cleared while the task is open, and never to a time in the past.

Requires one of the token scopes: `todo/tasks.write`.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Part of `task.name`, which has the form `tasks/{task}`.

parameters.name: updateMask
parameters.description:
The fields to change: title, notes or deadline_time. A deadline_time
named here but left empty clears the deadline. Empty changes every
field the task sets.

post.description:
Marks an open task as done. If a timer is running on the task, it stops and its time entry is written, so there is no need to stop it first. A task that is already done cannot be completed again.

Requires one of the token scopes: `todo/tasks.write`.

May publish the events: `commerce.todo.tasks.task.completed`. Each event carries only its type and the name of the resource it is about; consumers fetch the resource through this API.

with the same request_id after a failure succeeds and announces it

post.description:
Starts timing the caller's work on an open task, named by its resource name (tasks/...), and returns the running timer (timers/...). A person has one running timer at a time: if one is already running this fails with TIMER_ALREADY_RUNNING and that timer keeps going, so stop it first with stop_timer. A done task cannot be timed.

Requires one of the token scopes: `todo/timers.write`.
